kept.title: Arbitrary Code Execution via dynamic import of user-controlled filename
kept.description: The `getHandler` function in `src/entry/utils.ts` performs a dynamic `import(filename)` where `filename` is provided by the main process through inter-thread communication. Since the main thread takes this filename from user-provided input, an attacker can supply an arbitrary path to execute local code.
steps_to_exploit: Call `tinypool.run` with a `filename` pointing to a malicious local script
The worker thread receives the message and executes `getHandler` with the malicious path
The `import(filename)` statement triggers the execution of the attacker's code
kept.impact: Remote code execution within the context of the worker thread process.

kept.title: Lack of Input Sanitization for Task Function Names
kept.description: The `getHandler` function expects a `name` parameter to resolve an export. This name is used in a member access chain `(handler as any)[name]`, which is vulnerable to prototype pollution.
steps_to_exploit: Pass `constructor` or `__proto__` as the `name` argument to `runTask`
The `getHandler` function tries to access `handler['constructor']` or `handler['__proto__']`
The system behavior is altered due to access of prototype properties
kept.impact: Prototype pollution resulting in privilege escalation or DoS.

kept.title: Global state pollution in `process.__tinypool_state__`
kept.description: The pool stores internal flags in the global `process` object. This is a shared namespace and can be modified by any task running in the same process, causing unpredictable pool behavior.
steps_to_exploit: The internal pool logic reads the corrupted `workerId` or `isTinypoolWorker` flag
The pool logic fails to handle tasks correctly, leading to logic flaws
kept.impact: Security bypass or incorrect authorization if pool logic relies on these flags.

evidence.quote: process.__tinypool_state__ = { isChildProcess: true, isTinypoolWorker: true, workerData: null, workerId: Number(process.env.TINYPOOL_WORKER_ID), }
process.__tinypool_state__ = { isWorkerThread: true, isTinypoolWorker: true, workerData: workerData, workerId: tinypoolPrivateData.workerId, }

kept.title: Incomplete sanitization of worker environment
kept.description: The `initialize` method for `ProcessWorker` merges user-provided environment variables directly into the child process environment, potentially overriding critical system variables.
steps_to_exploit: Provide malicious environment variables (e.g., `NODE_OPTIONS`, `LD_PRELOAD`) in the `env` config
The worker is spawned with these variables
The worker executes code with modified environment behavior
kept.impact: Environment variable injection into child workers.
